newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Public further reduces 1,112 MW nuke output.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Public further reduces 1,112 MW nuke output.

text.p: Washington Public Power Supply System further lowered the output of its 1,112 megawatt (MW) WNP 2 nuclear unit while testing the unit's main turbine valves, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The unit in Richland, Wash, was operating at 24 percent of capacity, according to NRC, compared with 51 percent in Monday's report.
Washington Public Power is a consortium of municipal utilities in Washington state.
